subject.title: fix: surface portable runtime-mirror redirects and publish pruned stores back to checkouts

question: Should `gitcrawl portable prune` begin publishing into existing portable checkouts by default, with mirror-only pruning moved behind `--no-publish`?
rationale: This is an intentional upgrade-visible behavior change: it prevents stale exports, but it also changes whether an existing command mutates a user’s checkout and automation.

options.title: Adopt publish-by-default
options.body: Accept the new publishing boundary after reviewing redacted proof for both default publishing and `--no-publish` mirror-only behavior.

options.title: Keep mirror-only default
options.body: Preserve existing non-mutating prune behavior and expose checkout publication through an explicit separate option or command.

recommendation.title: Adopt publish-by-default
recommendation.body: Accept the new publishing boundary after reviewing redacted proof for both default publishing and `--no-publish` mirror-only behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence ties this contributor directly to the proposed portable-store contract, although current-main ownership history could not be established.
